verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe inspecting the summary and diff of cloud task results before opening a PR. They also document a dedicated `/review` against uncommitted changes, a commit, or a base branch that reports prioritized findings without touching the working tree, so risks can be addressed before committing or opening a PR. Running checks is supported through executing local dev tools and commands, including `codex exec` in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the review and diff workflow, and explicit documentation of running tests or linters as pre-merge checks (only implied by general command execution).
